name: obs-sglang-utilization-regression
notes: Contains the inline comment 'TODO: max_running_requests_under_SLO has no setter - sglang:utilization stuck at 0 (regressed #22713)'. _calculate_utilization falls back to getattr(self.scheduler, 'max_running_requests_under_SLO', None) and the scheduler passes max_running_requests_under_SLO=None with 'TODO: ... dead chain'. So sglang:utilization and sglang:max_running_requests_under_SLO are documented-but-dead on current main.
